title: Booking: Links I made now shows who booked
text: On Booking, Links and calls, once someone books through a link, the row shows who they are: their name with their email underneath. A link made for "Someone new" now shows the real booker instead. If the booker is not the person the link was made for (a different email or name), the row says "Booked by" in amber so it is easy to spot. Pointing at the name also shows their phone and any answers they gave. Calendly gives one name box, so the name is shown as the booker typed it.
points: Open Booking, then Links and calls, and look at the For column of a booked row
Point at the name to see the booker's phone and answers
